sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This AI Acceptable Use Policy establishes the governance framework for the deployment and utilization of artificial intelligence within {system_name} operated by {org_name}. This policy applies to all activities within the system boundary defined as {boundary} and specifically addresses the protection of {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. Approved AI Tooling and Monitoring

questions.prompt: Where is the approved AI tools list maintained?
How is the use of unapproved AI tools monitored and detected?

sections.body: To ensure security and compliance, only AI tools listed in the approved inventory located at {approved_tools_list_location} are permitted for use. The use of any AI tool not explicitly approved is strictly prohibited. Compliance with this restriction is enforced and monitored via {unapproved_tool_monitoring_method}.

sections.heading: 3. Data Input and Privacy Restrictions

questions.prompt: What specific types of data are prohibited from being entered into AI systems?
What are the approved guidelines for entering data into AI systems?

sections.body: The entry of data into AI systems must adhere to strict privacy and security standards. Specifically, {prohibited_data_types} must never be entered into any AI system. All authorized data entry shall be conducted according to the {data_entry_guidelines} to prevent the unauthorized disclosure of {cui_description}.
